comparison.reason: Cross-venue timestamps are asynchronous; order-book depth, fees, funding, withdrawal and settlement constraints are not synchronized.

depth.reason: Public depth endpoints did not return a usable synchronized L2 snapshot through the web renderer; ticker top-of-book sizes are not L2 depth.

exchange_balance_methodology.underlying_refresh: Daily XRPL account_info reads; page can refresh hourly from stored daily rows.
exchange_balance_methodology.method: Daily rippled account_info reads at latest validated ledger; wallet labels from XRPSCAN.
limitations: No per-wallet historical series.
Failed reads retain last good balance.
Newly labeled wallets enter at a 100,000 XRP threshold.
Same-wallet change excludes newly labeled wallets and can miss transfers to unlabeled addresses.
Cold wallets, wrapped assets and insurance/charity reserves are not customer tradable deposits.
The 22.35B figure is attributed labeled-wallet coverage, not total tradable float, exchange liabilities or proof of reserves.
The 323M outside the tracked set is a labeled-wallet floor, not total untracked exchange balance.

exchange_flow_observations.interpretation: Largest daily Binance XRP inflow in nearly six months; 90-day average reported above $100M/day.
limitations: Deposit does not establish sale.
Possible reserve replenishment after the October 29 Binance incident is an analyst hypothesis, not a verified attribution.
Same provider and analyst as the Nov 4 outflow observation.

exchange_flow_observations.interpretation: Largest daily Binance XRP outflow in nine months.
limitations: Withdrawal does not prove long-term accumulation.
Internal transfers remain possible.
Different date and measure from Nov 8 inflow; do not net them.

upbit_turnover.source: CryptoTicker; public Upbit interface figures, secondary analysis
upbit_turnover.fx_caveat: USD/KRW conversion uses ECB Nov 6 reference rate; not contemporaneous with Nov 9 Upbit quote.

etf_flow_observation.source: Bitcoin.com News citing SoSoValue; secondary tracker report
caveats: SoSoValue data was not directly accessible during this run.
Secondary report; not issuer-level primary reconciliation.
Net assets can decline from XRP price changes without ETF redemptions.
Tracker universe and methodology must be reconciled with other ETF datasets.

macro_event.interpretation: Upcoming macro event; no directional XRP effect assumed.

competing_hypotheses.name: continued_distribution_pressure
support: zero reported ETF net flows Nov 3-6
Upbit turnover high share but price falling and daily turnover declining
long-heavy liquidation observations from prior run
counterevidence: XRP Insights same-wallet 7d and 30d exchange balance declines
gross deposits do not prove selling

competing_hypotheses.name: reserve_replenishment_or_internal_rebalancing
support: CryptoQuant analyst explicitly raises reserve replenishment after Oct 29 incident as a possibility
gross outflow and inflow observations are on different dates
XRP Insights wallet-label and cold-storage coverage can create apparent flow changes
counterevidence: No verified wallet-by-wallet linkage from the 691M deposits to the incident
large deposits still increase exchange-held inventory if labels are correct

competing_hypotheses.name: deleveraging_exhaustion_or_absorption
support: long-heavy liquidation observations from prior run
declining Upbit daily turnover could indicate fading activity
counterevidence: no positive ETF flows Nov 3-6 in the cited tracker
no synchronized L2 depth or validated spot CVD series
